guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails during the RUN command that tries to update pip, setuptools, and wheel, and then update npm. The error "npm ERR! code EBADENGINE" indicates that the installed Node.js version is v12.22.9 which is incompatible with the npm version 11.16.0 being installed. npm requires Node.js version '^20.17.0 || >=22.9.0'. This suggests that the Node.js installation is not the intended v21 or later version. The cause is likely an order or caching issue in the Dockerfile or an incorrect Node.js installation method. To fix, ensure Node.js v21+ is correctly installed before running npm install -g npm@latest. One recommendation is to re-order the steps to install Node.js from NodeSource before upgrading npm globally, or explicitly remove any older Node.js versions before installing the new version. Also, verify no conflicting node installations present.
